init.title: Advanced options
init.description:
**API mode**: Leave on Auto unless you know you need to force V2 or V3 behavior.

**Websocket staleness detection** (V3 API mode only): Automatically reloads the integration if no updates are received for 4 minutes. This may help with connection issues but could cause unnecessary reloads. **Most users should leave this disabled.**

data.enable_staleness_detection: Enable automatic recovery from stale connections

data_description.api_version_override: auto = infer from charger and firmware, v2 = force legacy APIs, v3 = force updated APIs
data_description.enable_staleness_detection: Only enable if you experience lack of regular power sensor data with your V3 charger
